title: attach-diagnosis input spec
description: Input spec for ``attach-diagnosis`` — shape validation only.

classification.description: The investigator's classification, named from the CLOSED set the diagnosis-request disclosed (infra.failure_signatures.CLASSIFIER_CATEGORIES) or the literal 'unmatched' when no catalog category fits. Membership is enforced by the verb; free-text categories are refused.
classification.title: Classification

proposed_actions.description: Drafted recovery options, bounded. Proposals only.
proposed_actions.title: Proposed Actions

DiagnosisEvidenceExcerpt.description: One quoted log/artifact excerpt: WHERE it came from + the lines quoted.

path.description: The local file the excerpt was read from — one of the paths the diagnosis-request named (run sidecar, worker log, journal record). A pointer for the human to open; never fetched by any surface.
path.title: Path

lines.description: The quoted lines (verbatim excerpt, bounded). Display-only advisory matter — no gate or trusted surface ever reads this.
lines.title: Lines

DiagnosisEvidenceExcerpt.title: attach-diagnosis evidence excerpt

DiagnosisProposedAction.description: One DRAFTED recovery option — a proposal the human may read, never an answer.

label.description: Short name of the drafted option (e.g. 'raise mem_mb and resubmit').
label.title: Label

rationale.description: Why the investigator drafted it (agent judgment, advisory).
rationale.title: Rationale

suggested_response_text.description: Text the HUMAN could choose to type as their park answer. Never auto-filled, never rendered as an answer-menu option (the menu is code-authored data only) — the human reads it from the dossier render and decides.
suggested_response_text.title: Suggested Response Text

DiagnosisProposedAction.title: attach-diagnosis proposed action
